checks.description: Avoid: The 'Stock assets & +1 TB cloud storage' add-on on the review page used to start unticked; it now starts pre-added (selected: true in buildLines) for every buy-mode purchase, so the shopper pays for it unless they notice and click 'No, thanks'. The account cancellation page was also updated to state plainly that this add-on stops with the plan, so a shopper who later notices the charge and cancels isn't left wondering whether it keeps billing.
